about_the_game:
🔥 Gameplay Overview

Adult Simulation Redefined – Step into the life of a 22-year-old navigating lust, secrecy, and danger. Every action on your computer risks exposure: will you play it safe, or push your luck for greater rewards?

Dynamic State System – Switch between Normal, Naked, and Masturbating states (plus the risky Lowered Tab). Each state unlocks different apps, content, and opportunities—while raising suspicion if you’re caught.

Intrusions That Matter – Footsteps in the hallway, a knock on the door, and then entry. Intrusions play out differently depending on your state and relationship level, with over 40+ intrusion scenarios per character.

Suspicion Meter – Your lifeline. Get discovered too often and it’s game over. Manage risk to keep progressing deeper into relationships and content.

👩‍🎤 Characters & Relationships

Heart Progression System – Build relationships across 6 stages (0-5 hearts) with family members, friends, and OnlySins models. Conversations, media, and scenes evolve as bonds deepen.

Types of Characters:

  • OnlySins Based: Popular creators and models who start online but may cross into real life

Content Volume Per Character – 50+ conversations, 100+ images, 50+ videos/scenes, intrusion variations, fantasy scenes, room visits, OnlySins posts, livestreams, and unlockable collabs.

⚡ Apps & Features

  • OnlySins – A fully simulated adult platform with subscription tiers, profiles, livestreams, and unlockable collabs

  • Message-Her – Progress relationships through text, images, videos, and pivotal scenes

  • Moan-ey Maker – Earn money with minigames, gambling, and by posting your own creator content

  • Kinkazon – Buy skins, backgrounds, and creator equipment

  • Spycams – Install cameras in the house for voyeur events

  • Gallery – Revisit everything you’ve unlocked

🌍 Progression & Replayability

  • Risk vs Reward Gameplay – Balance content access with the danger of discovery

  • Multiple Locations – Access your room views, girls’ rooms, train rides, boat trips, and more

  • Creator Studio – Build your own OnlySins empire: choose themes, equipment, and models to produce interactive erotic videos

  • Fantasy Scenes – Optional dream sequences that unlock extra sexual content earlier in progression

Interested in what we do?
Check out our website or join our discord server!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU with DirectX 11 support (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires MP4/H.264 decoding support (built into Windows).
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500 / AMD Ryzen 3 or better
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (GeForce GTX 660 / Radeon HD 7850 or newer)
